title: Jesse Dean
clean_html:
Jesse Dean

Preserved Primary Document • dean-j4.htm

He appeared in the Orphans Court records on the estate of his deceased father when a guardian had to be appointed. He had at least one child : Ernest Clarence Dean (b.c. 1878) In the 1880 Kenton Hundred , Kent Co. census, Jesse was found living with Sarah, Ernest , his father-in-law, James Seeney (age 57) and 2 brothers-in law, John (age 30) and Joseph (age 11). In the Kent Co. Deeds (Liber U, Vol. 17) for 17 December, 1895 recording the sale of lands once owned by Robert Dean, Jesse is shown living in Kent Co., DE. Jesse died 12 August, 1931 and is buried at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold., DE. The grave marker is engraved -Jesse Dean (1858-1931). Buried nearby are E.C. Dean (son Ernest Clarence ?), S. A. Dean (wife Sarah???) and Edward and Laura Carter (no dates). His death certificate lists his age as "73" , his race as "Moor".
